newsitem.title: USA: Hurco sees Q2 income from settlement.
newsitem.headline: Hurco sees Q2 income from settlement.

text.p: Hurco Cos Inc said Thursday it expects to recognize income of about $5.0 million after taxes and expenses in its fiscal second quarter ending April 30, as a result of a patent settlement.

Hurco said its IMS Technology Inc subsidiary reached a settlement with Fanuc Ltd. Under the settlement, IMS will license its patent to Fanuc and certain related parties, and Fanuc will make a substantial one-time payment to IMS.
The settlement relates to an IMS patent for certain interactive computer numerical control (CNC) technology originally developed by Hurco, the company said.
Fanuc makes machine tools and CNC systems. Hurco also produces CNC systems, designed and built in the United States for stand-alone machine tools.
As previously reported, the IMS patent is the subject of several pending infringement and other actions involving a number of manufacturers and end-users of CNCs, Hurco said.
In connection with this settlement, IMS and Fanuc have dismissed claims against each other, Hurco said. Other terms of the settlement are confidential.
